UI_NOM_ScreenFx_tooltip: Film grain, a breathing vignette, static lines when the Faceless is near and a red flash when a Mourner screams. Only on your screen.
UI_NOM_ScreenFxIntensity_tooltip: 0 turns the effects off, 1 is the default, 2 is double.
UI_NOM_Dizzy_tooltip: When the Otherworld starts to spread, the screen sways and blurs for about 5 seconds (without the Shader mod, the vignette pulses and the screen darkens). On-screen dizziness bothers some people: turn it off if it makes you feel unwell. Off when screen effects are off.
UI_NOM_FogOverlayDensity: Blood and decay in the fog
UI_NOM_FogOverlayDensity_tooltip: How much blood, grime, cracks and decay the fog spreads on the floors and walls around you. 0 turns it off, 1 is the default, 2 is double. Red fog is always heavier.
UI_NOM_Dissolve_tooltip: Monster pieces form and fall apart with a burning edge when a zombie turns and turns back, and Echoes burn away with embers when they die. Off: instant swap, as before.
UI_NOM_Bloom_tooltip: Glow around bright lights, stronger in the fog. Only with the optional Shader mod (not with ShadowZ). 0 turns it off.
UI_NOM_FogQuality_tooltip: 0 low, 1 medium, 2 high: how many steps the volumetric fog uses per pixel. Lower it if the FPS drops in the fog. Only with the optional Volumetric mod (Java).
UI_NOM_FlowResolution_tooltip: 1 to 3 cells per tile in the fog motion: higher means finer waves and gaps around houses, using more CPU (runs outside the game frame). Only with the optional Volumetric mod (Java).
UI_NOM_BodyEmbers_tooltip: With burn in and out on: when a zombie turns into a monster and back, its whole body burns away in embers instead of only the monster piece. Off: only the piece burns.
UI_NOM_DebugPanelKey_tooltip: Opens and closes the NOM: Noise of Mist debug button panel. Only shown with the game in -debug. Default: Insert (F7 opens the game's vehicle editor in -debug). In the console: NOM.panel().
UI_NOM_Debug_LogEmpty: Click an action: whatever the mod replies shows up here.
UI_NOM_Debug_Sec_Fog_Desc: Opens, switches and ends the mod's fog. The siren warns first; monsters are only released with the fog open.
UI_NOM_Debug_Sec_Time_Desc: The mod's night and the game clock. The night drives the Eco and the hunting zombies; the hour moves the real clock.
UI_NOM_Debug_Sec_Monsters_Desc: Spawns zombies, pulls the nearest one and turns it into one of the monsters. Monsters only exist with the fog open.
UI_NOM_Debug_Sec_Storm_Desc: Lightning, rain, a flickering lamppost and what comes with the fog: the Estalador sonar, the wander wave and the wind.
UI_NOM_Debug_Sec_Player_Desc: Cheats to test without dying. The button shows whether it is on; click to flip it.
UI_NOM_Debug_Sec_Ash_Desc: Fog flakes and ash: density, spawn rate and floating ash. Applies to all three fog colors while fog is open. Sliders are live (this debug session only).
UI_NOM_Debug_Sec_Diag_Desc: Shows the mod state down here, under Replies (and in the console).
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Ash_Desc: Fine-tune ash/flakes: density and rate multiply ground/wall spawn; air multiplies floating ash. Show prints state; Reset returns to the 1.0 defaults.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_White_Desc: Locks the fog white and opens it: omen (3 s of screen static), the siren plays (zombies freeze), the fog rises and monsters are released in 30 s. With the fog open or the siren counting, it starts over. "Open now" skips the omen and the wait: the siren plays and the fog opens right away.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Red_Desc: Locks the fog red and opens it: omen, the red siren plays, the fog rises and monsters are released in 30 s. With the fog open or the siren counting, it starts over. "Open now" skips the omen and the wait: the siren plays and the fog opens right away.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Black_Desc: Locks the fog black: omen, out-of-tune siren, darkness and the Ticoes, which only move in the dark. "Open now" skips the omen and the wait.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_End_Desc: Ends the open fog or cancels the siren that is counting.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_FogLook_Desc: Shows sandbox base height, haze and pocket aggression, and pushes them again to the Volumetric mod.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_FogToggle_Desc: The old shortcuts, without locking the color. "Toggle" plays the siren and opens in 30 s, or ends the fog (and cancels the siren); "Open now" plays the siren and opens right away; "Red" flips the color of the open or incoming fog, and with nothing open starts a red one through the omen.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Night_Desc: Forces the mod's night (Eco, hunting zombies) or day, without touching the clock. "Clock" goes back to following the game time.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Hour_Desc: Moves the game clock forward to the chosen hour: an hour that already passed is tomorrow's.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Spawn_Desc: Plain zombies spread 3 tiles in front of you.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Variant_Desc: The nearest zombie becomes the chosen monster (fog open only). "Undo" removes the forced change; the fog's normal roll still applies.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Pull_Desc: The nearest living zombie on the same floor lands right on you.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Eco_Desc: An Eco at your feet (night only).
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Alma_Desc: White fog only: spawns a small wave of skeletal souls in the street (mostly crawlers, short TTL).
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Thunder_Desc: Lightning and thunder now, near you. In the black fog, the flash freezes the Ticoes for 1 s.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Lamp_Desc: A lit street lamppost (outdoors, up to 25 tiles) flickers now.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Rain_Desc: Turns rain on or off for every black and red fog. When off, it rains in 30%% of them.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Sonar_Desc: The nearest Estalador (in the fog, up to 60 tiles) clicks now; without one, the ring starts at your feet. Standing or walking, the ring finds you; crouched and still, it passes.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Ambient_Desc: Play a distant human scream now (this client only, never a horde). Needs fog up and FogAmbience; silent in black fog.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Wander_Desc: Fog open only: groups of 1 to 3 idle zombies near you start walking.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_CarpWalk_Desc: Next calm Carpideira owned here starts a short crying walk (Witch pilot).
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Wind_Desc: Turns the wind focus of the optional Volumetrica mod on or off.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_GodMode_Desc: God, invisible and zombies that do not attack, all together. The button follows god mode.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Status_Desc: Night, fog, monsters and clock, from this client and from the server.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Ticao_Desc: Black fog: how many Ticoes this process simulates and how many the light freezes right now.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_BlackPressure_Desc: Black fog pressure level (Light / Standard / Nightmare) and the live numbers: flicker, hold, hunt and streetlights.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Blind_Desc: How many zombies are blind and watched by the fog right now, and how the last wander wave went.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_OwnSprites_Desc: How many of the Otherworld's own textures are registered and which are missing.
UI_NOM_Debug_C_Help_Desc: Every NOM.* console command, with what each one does, down here under Replies.
